defects.title: WaiterPWA bill sheet lacks discount (indirim) application functionality
defects.invariant: Waiter must be able to apply line-level or bill-level discounts before sending to cashier, with role-based authorization
defects.mechanism: WaiterPWA bill.js renderDraftLine (lines 238-284) and renderSentLine (lines 286-348) show no discount UI; items render price, quantity, modifiers, notes, void/comp buttons — no discount field or button; Cashier split-payment.js:918-931 has tip buttons but discount mechanism not confirmed in waiter context; server would need discount eligibility in AllowedCommands or item-level canDiscount
defects.acceptance: WaiterPWA bill sheet adds discount button/field for eligible items/bills, gated by server AllowedCommands or role policy, sending discount request to server

limitations: Static review only; server discount API and role gating not examined; Cashier discount mechanism not verified
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
